notes.title: Community patch day 3!
notes.content:
[h1]Community Patch, Day 3.
Thank you to everyone who played and enjoyed our fantastic game.
This patch is for you; you asked for the ability to adjust sound effects and music from the options menu, and here it is!
- Updated mouse bug in all submenus
- Fixed L1 bonus zoom bug
- Fixed missing sound effects[/h1]

notes.title: PATCH DAY 1!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Here’s what we’ve fixed for the Day 1 patch. LEVEL 1 [/p][list][*][p]Enemy waves now block the screen as intended. No more skipping attack phases.[/p][p]LEVEL 1 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]corrected a bug with side hits that could trigger unfair damage in some cases.Fixed a movement issue that could cause V to get stuck in certain situations. [/p][p]LEVEL 7 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]Submarines now appear earlier. The fight is more balanced and clear.[/p][p]LEVEL 8 - BOSS[/p][/*][*][p]Boss and copy-boss rebalanced. The fight should now be smoother.[/p][p]SFX Ongoing [/p][/*][*][p]rebalancing of all sound effects across all levels[/p][p]MENU bug [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu bug where buttons wouldn't press, mouse issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]There are still a few small bug fixes underway, including the sliders for adjusting SFX and MUSIC. Thanks for all the support! LETS RAGING![/b][/p][/*][/list]
